Types
of
Rolling :

Over
the
course
of
the
study
I
was
able
to
identify
six
types
of
rolling .

( see
Table
2 ) .
Some
of
them
differ
only
by
the
plane
of
rolling
or
relative

body
position .
They
are
described
below .
All
bouts
of
rolling
were

divided
into
incidents ,
and
each
time
a
new
type
of
rolling
began
it
was

considered
a
new

Head
to
Head
Horizontal
Rolling :

This
type
of
rolling
has
never
been
described
in
the
literature .
In
head

to
head
horizontal
rolling
one
seal
grasps
the
other
by
the
throat
or

the
back
of
the
head
with
its
teeth
and
begins
spinning
rapidly
in
a

horizontal
plane ,
in
an
extended
bite
( see
Figure
2 ) .
The
two
seals
are

parallel
to
the
substrate ,
their
heads
in
close
proximity ,
forming
a

straight
line
with
their
bodies .
The
seal
being
grasped
does
not
seem
to

have
any
control
over
its
speed
of
rotation ;
the
grasping
seal
seems
to

completely
dominate
the
encounter .
I
did
not
see
this
type
after
May
7 .

to
head
